title: Modernize Apple sign-in and introduce accessible glass controls
criteria: Sign-in, loading and credential recovery use coherent native presentation on iPhone/iPad and TV.
Availability-guarded genuine glass controls preserve minimum OS support and accessibility fallbacks.
Existing authentication identifiers, account storage, localization and recovery behavior remain intact.
Both Apple apps compile with current SDK and changes are Apple-only.

title: Modernize iPhone and iPad library navigation
criteria: Library chooser, browse/search/filter, details and related catalog journeys use adaptive native navigation and controls.
iPhone and compact/wide iPad layouts remain readable with large text and both appearances.
All existing catalog actions and accessibility identifiers remain reachable.

title: Modernize Apple listening controls and player presentation
criteria: Compact playback floats in appropriate system glass above content without obscuring navigation.
Expanded playback, chapter/speed/sleep/bookmark controls use coherent native presentation.
Existing audio lifecycle, background/remote controls, progress recovery and offline playback remain unchanged.

title: Modernize Apple reading, downloads and account utilities
criteria: Reader chrome, downloads, podcasts/queues, settings/accounts, diagnostics and statistics match the redesigned Apple presentation.
Reading text and artwork remain content surfaces; opaque accessibility fallbacks remain usable.
All existing utility actions, localization and stored preferences remain intact.

title: Modernize Apple TV browsing and listening
criteria: TV navigation, search, library/detail/related screens, player and settings adopt native glass/control presentation.
Focused actions remain conspicuous and legible across the room, with Back and Play/Pause behavior intact.
TV minimum OS and device capability fallbacks preserve existing behavior.

title: Verify and ship the complete Apple redesign
criteria: Existing relevant native/UI journeys pass for iPhone/iPad and TV; meaningful failures are fixed.
Actual platform screenshots and accessibility/layout evidence cover all three device families.
Review the full integration diff, fix findings, merge the integration PR and provide verified Apple candidate build evidence.
Refresh only Apple-facing docs/release evidence and preserve public distribution rights gates.
No Android, browser or backend runtime changes are included.
